purpose: Orthogonal portfolio mission C: give the shared runtime a real consequential Project Brain maintenance goal without prescribing the solution path. The runtime must inspect live canonical state, decide what is materially inconsistent or stale, choose appropriate tools, make only evidence-supported repairs, and verify the result. This distinguishes an autonomous shared runtime from a static recipe executor.

goal.objective: Inspect the live Project Brain canonical state and remove one currently material contradiction or stale frontier defect, if one exists, while preserving all valid evidence and laws.
constraints: do not alter valid historical evidence
search prior canonical evidence before mutation
if no material contradiction exists, produce evidence for that conclusion rather than inventing work
